scope: Authorized mean-versus-worst paired-normal control; at most 1024 updates; no external weights or automatic budget extension.
question: Does worst pairing improve official real ranking and retained-normal protection at matched overall false-positive requirements relative to mean pairing?
sampling: same 240-world probabilities, SeedSequence([seed,7,draw]) frame requests, SeedSequence([seed,11,draw]) queries and original-forward order as results/short; two complete scans per update

evaluation.train_scope: same fixed 206 training-source diagnostic set; report actual world-frame requests
evaluation.synthetic_targets: all valid frozen labels including zero-anomaly and fewer-than-five-return frames; official filter secondary
evaluation.thresholds: retain each arm's 206 pooled 1% FPR threshold transferred to 201; additionally reuse paired scores at that arm's own complete 201 pooled <=1% FPR point; no witness-specific thresholds; same threshold before and after insertion
evaluation.full_val19_scope: all complete official point sets across the 19 public development sequences; remains development evidence, not an independent test
evaluation.interpretation: compare AP, FPR95 and recall at <=1% FPR; report actual 201 operating FPR and anomaly recall beside normal transitions; do not compare unequal keep-loss definitions as detection performance

decision: Worst pairing is useful only if normal protection accompanies a better overall AP/FPR95 tradeoff without sacrificing anomaly recall. Case-only gains cannot establish a core contribution. If unsupported, retain mean; no automatic tuning or budget extension.
stop: after 1024 updates and both final full-val19 evaluations, or immediately on numerical failure; preserve state; no automatic parameter retry; formal full training remains paused
